onboarding_voice_body: Your language and text size are saved. Allow microphone access now if you want to use voice with Agak.

onboarding_mic_explainer: Your microphone is used only when you choose to speak. You’ll be asked to allow microphone access.
onboarding_mic_unavailable: I can't use the microphone right now. You can type instead.
onboarding_live_unavailable: I can't show your words while you speak. Tap Finish when you're done.
onboarding_transcript_error: I couldn't understand that. Try again or continue without voice.
onboarding_transcript_empty: I didn't hear any words. Try again or continue without voice.
onboarding_mic_denied: Microphone access wasn't granted. Tap Try again.
onboarding_no_other_permissions: AgakAI doesn't need any other device permissions.
onboarding_permissions_prompt: To finish setup, allow the microphone and location.
onboarding_language_prompt: Hi, I'm Agak. Pick the language you'd like for the app.
onboarding_text_prompt: Pick the text size that's easiest for you. You can change it later.
onboarding_mic_prompt: Tap Enable microphone. When asked, tap Allow so Agak can hear your questions. Nothing is recorded during setup.
onboarding_location_prompt: Tap Allow location. When asked, allow location access to show where you are on the map.
onboarding_mic_prompt_android: Tap Enable microphone. When asked, choose “While using the app” so Agak can hear your questions. Nothing is recorded during setup.
onboarding_location_prompt_android: Tap Allow location. When asked, choose “While using the app” to show where you are on the map.
onboarding_audio_unavailable: I can't play the instructions right now. You can read them on the screen.
onboarding_audio_tap_to_play: Tap the speaker button to hear the message.
onboarding_audio_interrupted: The instructions stopped. Tap to hear them again.
onboarding_permission_settings_hint: Tap Open app settings. Turn this on, then come back.
onboarding_settings_opened: Turn it on in Settings, then come back here.
onboarding_settings_manual: Open your device settings and find the app with the Agak logo. Allow the microphone or location, then return here.
onboarding_location_denied: Location access wasn't granted. Tap Try again.
login_guidance: Nice work. Enter your Senior ID and six-digit PIN to sign in.
welcome_after_login: Ask me anything or explore benefits.
map_location_ready: The blue dot shows where you are. The place you chose is named on the map.

map_coords_missing: We don't have this place's address yet.
